footer.tagline: Imifundaze nemisebenzi ehambisana neziqu zakho - ngezizathu kuwo wonke amakhadi.
footer.disclaimer: I-Opportunistic™ ivela ohlwini lwezinkampani zangaphandle futhi ayikhiphi noma yimuphi umfundaze noma umsebenzi. Qinisekisa umnqamulajuqu nokufaneleka kusayithi lomthombo. Sisebenzisa isisekelo sobumfihlo sesitayela se-GDPR emhlabeni jikelele; Ikhukhi ne-analytics amathuluzi alayisha kuphela ngemvume yakho.

cookies.caption: Izilawuli zobumfihlo
cookies.title: Ukusetshenziswa kwamakhukhi nedatha
cookies.body: Sisebenzisa amakhukhi adingekayo ukuze sikugcine ungene ngemvume futhi ukhumbule le nketho. Amakhukhi angakhethwa asiza izintandokazi, izibalo, nokumaketha — kuphela uma uzivumela. Iqondana namalungelo esitayela se-GDPR emhlabeni jikelele.
cookies.prefsBody: Shintsha noma nini. Amakhukhi adingekayo awakwazi ukuvalwa — anika amandla i-auth, ukuphepha, nokugcina le nketho.
cookies.necessaryDesc: Iseshini yokungena ngemvume, ukuphepha, irekhodi lemvume
cookies.preferencesDesc: Khumbula ukukhetha kwe-UI ngale kwekhukhi yemvume
cookies.marketingDesc: Izikhangiso / omaka bokuphinda bamakethwe — neze ngaphandle kwemvume

landing.title: Opportunistic
landing.headline: Qondanisa imifundaze nemisebenzi nephrofayili yangempela.
landing.lede: Faka amakhono neziqu. Opportunistic ilinganisa izikhala futhi ichaze ukulingana kuwo wonke amakhadi.
landing.howMatchingBody: Okuphakelayo kwephrofayela → sesha → uthole imiphumela enezizathu.
landing.whatShipsBody: Izifundiso, imisebenzi ngezwe, umhleli wephrofayela, ukususwa.
landing.whyExistsBody: Ukulahlwa kwezixhumanisi kuziba irekhodi lakho. Asazi.
landing.ctaBody: Ukugibela kuqoqa izwe, amakhono, neziqu — bese kuqala ukufanisa.

settings.title: Amasethingi we-akhawunti
settings.privacyCookiesBody: Phatha amakhukhi ongawakhetha noma nini. Amakhukhi adingekayo ahlala evuliwe ukuze uvikeleke futhi ukhumbule le nketho.

profile.title: Hlela iphrofayela yakho
profile.lede: Ukonga ukuphinda kuqalise ukufanisa imifundaze nemisebenzi.
profile.headline: Isihlokwana
profile.skillsHint: Thikha amakhono afanele amadigri akho. Sebenzisa Okunye kunoma yini engekho.
profile.saveSuccess: Iphrofayela ilondoloziwe. Okufanayo kuphinde kwatholwa kusukela kuziqu zakho zakamuva namakhono.

howItWorks.title: Yondla isistimu. Thola amameshi asezingeni.
howItWorks.lede: Chofoza isigaba ngasinye noma ubuke umjikelezo wekhonsoli: ngenisa idatha yephrofayela, cubungula imibuzo, imiphumela ecatshangelwayo.
howItWorks.cadenceBody: Ukufanisa kusebenza ekudaleni iphrofayela, lapho uhlela iziqu, amakhono, noma izwe, futhi ngohlelo lwamasonto onke — hhayi kukho konke ukuvakasha kwedeshibhodi.
howItWorks.trustBody: Siveza izinhlu ezivela kumabhodi wangempela namaphothali. Njalo qinisekisa umnqamulajuqu kusayithi lomthombo. Iminqamulajuqu edlule ihlungwa kudeshibhodi yakho.
howItWorks.ctaBody: Dala i-akhawunti futhi uqedele ukugibela ukuze ukhiqize okufanayo kwakho kokuqala.

features.title: Abafanisi ababili. Iphrofayili eyodwa.
features.lede: Scholarships emhlabeni wonke. Imisebenzi ngezwe. Izikolo nezizathu zihlala ekhadini.
features.scholarshipBody: Amadigri namakhono akho kuqhuba usesho. Ikhadi ngalinye lomfundaze libonisa amaphuzu + ukuthi kungani lilingana.
features.jobBody: Iphrofayili efanayo, injini yesibili. Imisebenzi ihlonipha izwe olikhethile - ngamanothi afanelekile asobala.
features.jobPoint3: Londoloza noma chitha ukufakwa kuhlu ngakunye
features.profileBody: Izwe → ngawe → iziqu → amakhono. Ukuhlela kamuva kuphinda kuhlangane ngokuzenzakalelayo.
features.privacyBody: Ukususwa kwezinga le-GDPR kwawo wonke umuntu. Ukususwa kwephrofayela kuya kumakhono, amakhono, namameshi.
features.gridReasonBody: Kungani umdlalo ngamunye ulingana uhlala ekhadini - hhayi ngemuva kwe-modal.
features.gridMobileBody: Iningi labafake izicelo lifika ngocingo; isakhiwo nokunyakaza kuyakuhlonipha lokho.
features.ctaBody: Gxumela ekuhambeni okugqwayizayo, noma qala ukwakha iphrofayela yakho.

about.title: Izifundiso nemisebenzi, ehambisana nezizathu.
about.lede: Yakhelwe abantu abakhathele ukuskrola amabhodi ajwayelekile. Faka okufundile kanye nalokho ongakwenza - silinganisa izikhala futhi sisho ukuthi kungani zilingana.
about.ideaTitle: Ukufanisa kufanele kuzwakale njengokwaziswa, hhayi ukulahlwa kwezixhumanisi.
about.ideaBody1: Izinjini zokusesha kanye namabhodi amathuba abonisa ivolumu. Abavamile ukwazi i-Computer Science degree yakho, amakhono akho we-React, noma ukuthi ufaka isicelo eBotswana - futhi cishe abakaze bakuchaze ukufaneleka.
about.ideaBody2: Opportunistic igcina iphrofayili eyodwa ephilayo futhi iqhube umfundaze kanye nomsebenzi wokufanisa. Yonke imiphumela iphethe amaphuzu, umthombo, nesizathu ongasisebenzisa.
about.p1Body: Iziqu, amakhono, kanye nezwe kuwumthombo weqiniso. Okufanayo kuyakhiwa kabusha uma uwashintsha.
about.p2Body: Amaphuzu angenayo incazelo angumsindo. Sibhala ukuthi kungani ukufakwa kuhlu kufanelana — ngolimi olulula.
about.p3Body: Sithola futhi izinga. Ufaka isicelo kusizindalwazi esisemthethweni sokufunda noma somqashi.
about.areItem1: Umfundaze owazi iphrofayili kanye nokufana komsebenzi
about.areItem2: Amathiphu e-Playbook ahlukile kumakhono akho nezinjongo zakho
about.areItem3: Londoloza, chitha, futhi uqhathanise futhi uma iphrofayela yakho ishintsha
about.notItem1: Asinikezi imifundaze noma siqashe noma ubani
about.studioBody: I-Opportunistic™ iwumkhiqizo we-Futurify Designs — oklanyelwe ukuzwakala unembe, uzolile, futhi uwusizo, hhayi njengelinye ibhodi lesifanekiso.
about.ctaBody: Dala i-akhawunti, qinisekisa amakhono kusuka kuziqu zakho, futhi uvule umentshisi osezingeni ngezizathu.

match.gone: Lokhu okufanayo akusatholakali. Kungenzeka ukuthi ivuselelwe ngemva kokubuyekezwa kwephrofayela.
match.emptyBody: Buyela kudeshibhodi futhi uvule okufanayo kwamanje. Ukulondoloza iphrofayela yakho kwakha kabusha imiphumela evela kudatha yakho yakamuva.
match.playbookTitle: Ibhuku lakho lokudlala ukuze uwine lokhu
match.playbookNote: Amathiphu ahlukile akhiwe kusukela kuphrofayela yakho, amakhono, nalolu hlu. Zivuselela uma uhlela iphrofayela yakho — noma uthephe amathiphu amasha.
match.eligibilityNote: Njalo qinisekisa imithetho yakamuva emthonjeni osemthethweni — izinhlelo zishintsha ngomjikelezo nangobuzwe.
match.reasonFallback: Vula uhlu lomthombo bese uqhathanisa izimfuneko kuphrofayela yakho.

onboarding.guideCountryWhy: Imisebenzi ihlungwa yileli zwe. Ukuyishintsha kamuva kufana ngokuzenzakalela.
onboarding.guideYouTip: Igama liyadingeka. Isihlokwana siyisifinyezo sakho somugqa owodwa - njengomlando omfushane wokufanisa.
onboarding.guideYouWhy: Lena yindlela okufanisa ngayo "ukukhuluma" ngawe emigqeni yokucabanga.

privacy.title: Inqubomgomo yobumfihlo
privacy.lede: Isisekelo sokuvikela idatha yomhlaba wonke, izilawuli zekhukhi elisebenzayo, namalungelo acacile - kubuyekezwe ku-Opportunistic.
privacy.langNote: Le nqubomgomo egcwele iboniswa ngolimi olukhethile.

terms.title: Imigomo Yokusebenzisa
terms.lede: Imithetho yokusebenzisa Opportunistic njengesendlalelo sokuthola — hhayi njengomkhiphi wanoma yiliphi ithuba.

privacyBody.overview: Opportunistic (“thina”) sihlinzeka ngomfundaze kanye nokufanisa umsebenzi. Le nqubomgomo ichaza ukuthi yini esiyiqoqayo, kungani, siyigcina isikhathi esingakanani, kanye namalungelo akho. Sisebenzisa isisekelo sebanga le-GDPR kuwo wonke umsebenzisi emhlabeni jikelele, futhi siyayihlonipha imithetho yendawo eqinile lapho isebenza khona (okuhlanganisa i-UK GDPR, i-POPIA eNingizimu Afrika, nezinhlaka ezifanayo). Lesi isiqondiso esisebenzayo sokuthobela umkhiqizo wethu — akusona iseluleko esisemthethweni esisemthethweni endaweni yakho.
privacyBody.lawfulContractDesc: Ukudala i-akhawunti yakho, ukufanisa, nokuletha isevisi oyicelayo
privacyBody.lawfulConsentDesc: Amakhukhi ozikhethela (izibalo/ukuthengisa), i-imeyili igaya okhetha ukungena kuzo
privacyBody.lawfulLegitimateDesc: Ukuphepha, ukuvimbela ukuhlukunyezwa, ukwethembeka kwesevisi - kulinganisa namalungelo akho
privacyBody.lawfulLegalDesc: Lapho kufanele sigcine noma sidalule idatha ngaphansi komthetho osebenzayo
privacyBody.storeProfileDesc: Igama, izwe, isihloko, umlando, iziqu, namakhono owafakayo
privacyBody.storeMatchesDesc: Isihloko, i-URL, umthombo, ukucabanga, amaphuzu, futhi londoloza/chitha isimo
privacyBody.storeTechnicalDesc: Ikhukhi lemvume, amakhukhi esikhathi adingekayo ukuze ungene ngemvume, izibalo ozikhethela uma uzivumela
privacyBody.cookiesIntro: Sisebenzisa ikhukhi lemvume (opp_consent) ukuze sikhumbule ukukhetha kwakho kuze kube yizinyanga eziyi-12. Amakhukhi adingekayo agcina ukuqinisekiswa kuvikelekile. Okuncamelayo, izibalo, namakhukhi wokumaketha alayisha kuphela ngemva kokungena. Ungashintsha umqondo wakho noma nini.
privacyBody.cookiesNecessaryDesc: Iseshini yokugunyaza, ukuphepha, ukugcina le mvume
privacyBody.cookiesAnalyticsDesc: Isilinganiso sokusetshenziswa — imibhalo ivinjiwe kuze kuvunyelwe
privacyBody.cookiesMarketingDesc: Amathegi esikhangiso / okuthengisa kabusha — imibhalo ivinjiwe kuze kuvunyelwe
privacyBody.useBody: Iphrofayela yakho inika amandla amathiphu afanayo nacatshangwayo. Asithengisi idatha yomuntu siqu. Asizisebenzisi iziqu zakho ukuze sakhe amaphrofayili okukhangisa ngaphandle uma uvumela ngokusobala amakhukhi wokumaketha kanye nozakwethu wesikhangiso wesikhathi esizayo uvezwe lapha.
privacyBody.transfersBody: Ingqalasizinda ingase icubungule idatha ezifundeni ezisetshenziswa abahlinzeki bethu (isibonelo, i-Supabase ne-Brevo). Lapho idatha iphuma ezweni lakini, sithembele ekuvikelweni okufanele okuqashelwa ngaphansi kwemithetho yesitayela se-GDPR (njengemibandela yenkontileka evamile enikezwa yilabo bahlinzeki) futhi sinciphise esikugcinayo.
privacyBody.retentionBody: Ukuhlala kwe-akhawunti nokufanisa idatha ngenkathi i-akhawunti yakho isebenza. Uma ususa idatha yakho kokuthi Izilungiselelo, sisusa iphrofayela, iziqu, amakhono, okufanayo, nomlando wosesho kusizindalwazi sohlelo lokusebenza. Ukuhlanzwa kwe-akhawunti ye-Auth-akhawunti nakho kungacelwa ku-hello@opportunistic.online. Amarekhodi emvume angase agcinwe njengobufakazi bokuzikhethela kuze kube yiminyaka yokuphila kwekhukhi noma njengoba kudingwa umthetho.
privacyBody.rightsBody: Kuye ngokuthi uhlala kuphi, ungase ube namalungelo okufinyelela, ukulungisa, ukususa, ukukhawulela, into, idatha yokungena, nokuhoxisa imvume. Siyakuhlonipha lokhu njengesisekelo somhlaba wonke. Ungahlela iphrofayela yakho noma nini futhi ususe idatha yakho kokuthi Izilungiselelo.
privacyBody.childrenBody: Opportunistic ayiqondiswe ezinganeni ezingaphansi kweminyaka engu-16 (noma iminyaka ephakeme yemvume yedijithali ezweni lakini). Ungayidali i-akhawunti uma ungaphansi kwaleyo minyaka. Uma sifunda ukuthi sibamba idatha enjalo, sizoyisusa.
privacyBody.sharingBody: Sabelana ngedatha nabacubungula abasiza ukuqalisa isevisi: I-Supabase (i-auth/database), i-Brevo (i-imeyili yokwenziwayo uma inikwe amandla), nokubamba (our hosting providers). Uhlu luvulwa kumasayithi ezinkampani zangaphandle ngezinqubomgomo zawo. Asithengisi idatha yomuntu siqu.

termsBody.roleBody: Opportunistic inkundla yokuthola. Siveza umfundaze wezinkampani zangaphandle kanye nezinhlu zemisebenzi ngokusekelwe kuphrofayela yakho. Asibona abakhiphi, umqashi, noma umnikezeli wanoma yiliphi ithuba eliboniswa kusayithi.
termsBody.roleCallout: Qedela njalo izinhlelo zokusebenza ohlwini olusemthethweni lomthombo. Opportunistic ichaza kufanelekile; umthombo ungumnikazi wokufaneleka nemiphumela.
termsBody.accuracyBody: Uhlu lungaphelelwa isikhathi ngemva kokukhonjwa. Njalo qinisekisa ukufaneleka, umnqamulajuqu, nezinyathelo zokufaka isicelo kuwebhusayithi yomthombo ngaphambi kokufaka isicelo. Amaphuzu okufanisa, ukucabanga, namathiphu ayiseluleko — awazona iziqinisekiso zokwamukelwa, uxhaso, noma ukuqashwa.
termsBody.accountOthersDesc: Ungalayishi idatha yomuntu siqu yomunye umuntu ngaphandle kwemvume
termsBody.accountFairDesc: Singase simise ama-akhawunti ahlukumeza ukufanisa noma azame ukususa isevisi
termsBody.liabilityBody: Ngokwezinga eligcwele elivunyelwe umthetho, Opportunistic akabophezelekile ezinqumweni ezisuselwa kuhlu oluvele obala, okuhlanganisa namathuba avaliwe, okuqukethwe okungalungile kwenkampani yangaphandle, noma izicelo ezingaphumelelanga.
termsBody.privacyAfter: ichaza esikuqoqayo namalungelo akho. Amakhukhi ozikhethela kanye nobuchwepheshe obufanayo alayisha kuphela ngemva kokuvuma kwakho usebenzisa isibhengezo sekhukhi noma izilungiselelo zekhukhi. Amakhukhi adingekayo okuphepha, ukungena ngemvume, nokukhumbula lokho kukhetha ahlala evuliwe. Bheka
termsBody.changesBody: Singase sibuyekeze le migomo njengoba umkhiqizo ukhula. Idethi Ebuyekeziwe phezulu kuleli khasi ibonisa isibuyekezo sakamuva. Ukusetshenziswa okuqhubekayo ngemva kwezinguquko kusho ukuthi uyayamukela imigomo ebuyekeziwe.

tips.sRefereeGeneric: Vikela onompempe ababili abangacaphuna isinyathelo esithile osiqalile - izinhlamvu ezingacacile "zomfundi osebenza kanzima" zicwilisa amaphrofayili aqinile.
tips.sCalendar: Yakha umnqamulajuqu wekhalenda lokuhlehla lisuka kokuthi “{{deadline}}” elinamabhafa okuloba, izivivinyo, nezinkomba.
tips.sOffline: Okusalungiswa kuphendula ungaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi kuqala, bese unamathisele kuphothali - izinkinga zokulondoloza ngokuzenzakalela zisula amahora omsebenzi kumafomu amaningi ezifundo.
tips.sAlumni: Cwaninga abafundi abangu-2 abavela ku-{{place}} abawine {{source}}; qaphela lokho izicelo zabo ezikugcizelele futhi ubonise isakhiwo, hhayi indaba.
tips.sScore: Uma isikolo sakho sokufanisa singu-{{score}}%, phatha izikhala ngokwethembeka endabeni — amaphaneli avuza ukuzazi kangcono kunezimangalo zokuphelela.
tips.sHeadline: Qondanisa isihloko sakho (“{{headline}}”) nomsebenzi oshiwo wohlelo ukuze isikrini sokuqala vele sizizwe sinenhloso.
tips.sPitch: Lungiselela iphimbo lezwi lemizuzwana engama-60 lohlelo lwakho lokufunda lwezingxoxo: inkinga → unqenqema lwakho → {{source}} njengesisheshisi.
tips.sProof: Qoqa ama-artifact obufakazi (i-GitHub, imibiko, imiklomelo, izincwadi zomphakathi) ezisekela wonke amakhono owafakile — izithombe-skrini sezilungile ngaphambi kokufaka isicelo.
tips.sEligibility: Hlola ubuzwe kanye nezigatshana zokubuyela ekhaya {{source}} ngokumelene nesimo sakho {{country}} kulo mjikelezo — amaphutha okufaneleka amosha ama-eseyi aqinile.
tips.sBio: Bhala kabusha umlando wakho ukuze umuntu ongamazi kokuthi {{location}} aqonde indawo yakho ngomusho owodwa, bese andisa.
tips.sCheveningCourses: Khetha izifundo ezintathu zase-UK ezilingana ngempela {{field}}, hhayi ukuvelela kukodwa - I-Chevening inqaba ama-trios ezifundo ezingafani ngisho nangezincwadi eziqinile.
tips.sCheveningNet: Chitha ikhasi eligcwele ezinhlelweni “zenethiwekhi”: yiziphi izinhlangano zase-UK, amalebhu, noma amaqembu enqubomgomo ozowajoyina, nokuthi yini obuya nayo {{place}}.
tips.sDaadFilter: Hlunga i-DAAD ngezinga lakho ledigri elinembile futhi {{field}}, bese uhlu olufushane lwezingcingo ezi-2 - izinhlelo zokusebenza ezijwayelekile ze-"Germany" azivamile ukusula ukusika kokuqala.
tips.sDaadLang: Nquma kusenesikhathi ukuthi ngabe udinga ubufakazi besiJalimane noma besiNgisi bohlelo lomsingathi, bese ubhukha idethi yokuhlola ngaphambi kokuthi ucingo luvalwe.
tips.sMastercardApply: Faka isicelo ngenyuvesi ebambisene nayo efundisa {{field}} - I-Mastercard Scholars iqondene nekhampasi ethile, ayilona uhlobo olulodwa lomhlaba jikelele.
tips.sMastercardNeed: Bhala isidingo nobuholi ndawonye: isigaba esisodwa phezu kwezithiyo, esisodwa kulokho osuvele ukushintshile kwabanye {{place}}.
tips.sFulbrightPage: Sebenzisa ikhasi lezwe lakini le-Fulbright kuphela — umnqamulajuqu namafomu okuthi {{country}} ahluke encwajaneni yomhlaba wonke.
tips.sFulbrightObj: Yenza ucwaningo/inhloso yocwaningo ibe namanga: yimuphi umbuzo kokuthi {{field}} ozowuphendula ezinyangeni eziyi-12–24?
tips.sGates: I-Cambridge fit iza kuqala: qamba umphathi noma iqembu lelebhu elihlobene {{field}} ngaphambi kokupholisha isitatimende sikaGates.
tips.sTheme: Bopha isiphakamiso sakho netimu eshicilelwe evela kokuthi {{source}}, usebenzisa ulimi oluphuma ocingweni — ukungaqondi kahle kwetimu kuwukwenqaba okujwayelekile okuthulile.
tips.jResume: Phinda ubhale isifinyezo sakho se-CV yakho ukuze uhole ngokuthi {{skill}} + {{field}}, bese ulingisa izenzo ezi-5 eziphezulu ukusuka kwesinye nesinye {{source}} sikuthumela okuvuliwe.
tips.jProof: Yakha “ishidi lobufakazi” elinekhasi elingu-1 elinezinhlamvu ezi-3: inkinga, isenzo usebenzisa {{skills}}, umphumela olinganisekayo.
tips.jAdvanced: Faka {{skills}} engxenyeni yokuqala yesithathu ye-LinkedIn/Mayelana - abaqasha bayashushuluza, abazingeli.
tips.jWeak: Ngezindima ezidinga {{skill}}, engeza iphrojekthi encane yempelasonto bese uyixhumanisa — izimangalo eziphakathi nendawo ngaphandle kobufakazi ziyahlungwa.
tips.jAlerts: Setha {{source}} izexwayiso ze-“{{field}}" kanye nezwe lakini ({{country}}), bese usebenza phakathi kwamahora angu-48 okuthunyelwa.
tips.jTarget: Khomba izinkampani ezi-5 ngeviki eziqasha {{field}} ngaphakathi noma kusuka {{country}}, hhayi ukuchofoza okungu-50 kwe-Easy Apply okungahleliwe.
tips.jCover: Kuwo wonke amanothi ekhava, yisho okukodwa okuphathekayo okulethwayo ongakuthumela ezinsukwini zokuqala ezingu-30 usebenzisa isitaki sakho samanje.
tips.jReferrals: Cela ukudluliselwa kuphela ngemva kokuchaza umkhiqizo weqembu ngemisho emi-2 — obandayo uyabuza ngaphandle kokusha amabhuloho ngomsebenzi wesikole.
tips.jLoom: Rekhoda i-Loom yamasekhondi angu-90 (noma inothi lezwi) uhamba kuphrojekthi; inamathisele lapho {{source}} ivumela umlayezo/usebenzisa okungeziwe.
tips.jConfidence: Ukuzethemba kwakho komdlalo kwamanje kungu-~{{score}}% — uma kungaphansi kuka-70%, qinisa amakhono kuPhrofayela bese uphinde uqhathanise ngaphambi kokufafaza izinhlelo zokusebenza.
tips.jTranslate: Humusha ulimi lwezemfundo usuke kokuthi {{field}} uye olimini lomqashi: “umsebenzi wezifundo” → “kulethwe u-X ngaphansi komnqamulajuqu”.
tips.jLog: Gcina irekhodi lokulahla: indima, ikhono elilahlekile, isenzo esilandelayo - amaphethini akutshela ukuthi yini okufanele ufunde ngokulandelayo ngokushesha kunokuqagela.
tips.jLinkedinOpen: Vula Vula Emsebenzini (abaqashayo kuphela) bese uphina iphrojekthi efakiwe efakazela {{skill}}.
tips.jLinkedinComment: Beka amazwana ngokucatshangelwayo kokuthunyelwe kwabaphathi abaqashayo okungu-3 kokuthi {{field}} kuleli sonto ngaphambi kokufaka isicelo esibandayo — ukubonakala okufudumele kushaya buthule Sebenzisa.
tips.jIndeed: Sebenzisa isihlungi sendawo ye-Indeed ncamashi njengokuthi “{{country}}” futhi uhlele ngedethi — ukuthunyelwa okukudala kumosha amandla.
tips.jRemoteOk: Funda umugqa wezwe/wesikhathi sendawo kabili kokuthunyelwe Okukude KuLUNGILE — izindima eziningi “ezikude” zisangabandakanyi {{country}}.
tips.jRemoteRate: Intengo isilinganiso sikasonkontileka wakho kanye nendawo yesikhathi igqagqana ngaphambili kumlayezo wokuqala ukuze ugweme ukungenwa isipoki ngemva kwezikrini.
tips.jGlassdoor: Funda imibiko yakamuva yenhlolokhono yalowo mqashi, bese ulungiselela izindaba ezi-2 eziphendula iphethini yemibuzo ephindaphindwayo.
tips.jReliefImpact: Hola izinhlelo zokusebenza ezinomthelela wenkambu/wokuzithandela kokuthi {{place}} — I-ReliefWeb iqasha okuhlangenwe nakho okuhlobene nomsebenzi ohlobene nezinsimbi.
tips.jReliefLang: Qondanisa ulimi oluvela esikhaleni (i-MEAL, isivikelo, WASH, njll.) kuphela uma ukwazi ukukuvikela — ukugxilisa amagama kusobala.
tips.jHeadline: Vumelanisa isihloko sakho esisesidlangalaleni kokuthi “{{headline}}” noma kuphi lapho usebenzisa khona ukuze {{source}} izikrini kanye ne-CV yakho ixoxe indaba eyodwa.
